title: WG 160.3 WORXGT 20V 2.0
text: WG 160.3 WORXGT 20V 2.0. The wheels that come with it ( ostensibly to use it as a "mini mower") are virtually worthless over rough uneven ground. Some of the flora in my yard must have been too tough for it. I had to pull them out by the roots. Otherwise it is OK for lightweight yard work. Don't expect "brush hog" results for a "piglet" price.
